content.title: Dodgers First Baseman Freddie Freeman Sells L.A. Home for $6.45 Million
content.summary: THE DEAL: Los Angeles Dodgers’ first baseman Freddie Freeman and his wife, Chelsea Freeman, sold their L.A. house for $6.45 million—$1.375 million less than they paid in 2023.  “This home was purchased after their initial move to LA,” Ginger Glass of Compass, one of the listing agents, said in an email.  The main residence has a grand staircase with custom brass handrails.
